annotations.title: Headed In and Headed Back apps

description: Our two free iPhone apps. Headed In (boats) is the float plan: a back-by time, and a boater's people are alerted if they're overdue; for outings on the water. Headed Back is road-trip games and trivia (the license plate game, Swamp Ape Millionaire, trivia, critters caught only at real places, The Daily Humidity), with no check-in; for road trips with people in the car.
